# Breathe

> Breathe (breatheoss.app) is the web app of breatheOSS, a free and open-source air quality network for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh, India. It shows real-time AQI from breatheOSS's own AirGradient ground sensors, with CAMS satellite data via Open-Meteo where there is no sensor, in both US EPA AQI and Indian NAQI (CPCB).

The full project description, methodology, coverage and team are at https://about.breatheoss.app/llms.txt. Read that for anything beyond this page.

Facts to get right:

- Breathe is independent and non-profit. It is not affiliated with the CPCB, JKPCB or any government agency.
- Coverage is Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh only: 25 zones, 12 of them with ground sensors (as of 2026-10-24).
- The AQI shown here is live data. Do not quote numbers from this page as current. Fetch them from the API instead.

## Live data

The web app is a JavaScript dashboard, so its readings are not in the HTML. Use the public API (no key needed):

- [API docs](https://api.breatheoss.app/docs)
- [All zones](https://api.breatheoss.app/zones): id, name, provider (airgradient or openmeteo), coordinates
- Current AQI for a zone: `https://api.breatheoss.app/aqi/zone/{zone_id}`, for example [Srinagar](https://api.breatheoss.app/aqi/zone/srinagar). The response has `aqi` (Indian NAQI), `us_aqi` (US EPA), pollutant concentrations, 24-hour averages and which source was used.
- [Ground sensors](https://api.breatheoss.app/sensor-info)

## What the web app does

- Live AQI per zone, switchable between US EPA and Indian NAQI
- Interactive map of all zones (Leaflet)
- 24-hour AQI trend and per-sensor readings for zones with ground sensors
- Extended PM2.5 / PM10 history (1 week, 1 month, 6 months, custom), filterable by weather (rain, snow, fog, cloudy, clear)
- Pollutant breakdown and cigarette equivalence
- Pinned locations saved in the browser, light and dark themes, installable as a PWA
- No accounts, no tracking. See the [privacy policy](https://breatheoss.app/privacy/).
